title: resolve_secret_uri used inconsistently: some secretx sites use helper, others open-code the boilerplate
description: resolve_secret_uri() is defined in both transit/main.rs and reader/main.rs and used for bearer_token / admin_token. But TLS key and signing key resolution is open-coded inline (~25 lines each) instead of using the helper. The split is because resolve_secret_uri is UTF-8-string-only (.as_str()), while TLS/signing needs bytes. This is correct but undocumented — a future contributor will try to use resolve_secret_uri for a binary secret and get wrong behavior. Suggested fix: rename to resolve_secret_string_uri and add a parallel resolve_secret_bytes_uri, or add a comment on the helper explaining the binary limitation.
